summary: Decodes 32-bit packed RGB10A2 texture data into float RGBA. Computes a source pointer from offset 0x18 plus row/slice strides at 0x1050/0x1054, then loops this[0x1058] times extracting three 10-bit sign-extended color channels (scaled by 0.001953125) and a 2-bit alpha (scaled by 0.33333334) per pixel, writing four floats per output element. When the flag at 0x10 is non-zero, runs ContactManifoldCleanup over the decoded buffer.

Iterate i = &v4[this[0x1058]]; v4 < i; over the pixel count at offset 0x1058, advancing v4 one DWORD per pixel.
Extract the three 10-bit color fields with sign extension: R from bits 0-9, G from bits 10-19, B from bits 20-29 of the packed DWORD.
Scale each extracted channel by 0.001953125 into float R, G, B output values.
Write float RGBA for the pixel: R, G, B channels followed by alpha = (double)(*v4 >> 30) * 0.33333334, advancing a4 by 4 floats per pixel.
Guard on this[4] (flag at offset 0x10): if non-zero, run the post-process step over the decoded output buffer.
Call ContactManifoldCleanup(this, buffer-start) where buffer-start is a4 backed up by 4 * this[0x1058] floats, as the conditional post-process over the decoded RGBA buffer.
